This page documents mallard duck movement over time.

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
mallards <- readRDS("data/mallards.rds")
```

```{r}
mallards |>
  count(month, name = "fixes") |>
  arrange(month)
```

```{r}
mallards |>
  filter(speed <= 30) |>
  group_by(season, month) |>
  summarise(mean_speed = mean(speed, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  arrange(season, month)
```
